parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this Dynamic DNS Client.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Status of this Dynamic DNS Client.

parameters.name: LastError
parameters.description: The last error this Dynamic DNS Client has encountered. The parameter MAY instead indicate a vendor-specific cause, which MUST use the format defined in {{bibref|TR-106}}.

parameters.name: Server
parameters.description: The DynamicDNS server associated with this Dynamic DNS Client. {{reference}}

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: The IP interface over which update queries to the server are sent. {{template|INTERFACE-ROUTING}} {{reference}}

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: Username used by this Dynamic DNS Client to authenticate with the Server.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Password used by this Dynamic DNS Client to authenticate with the Server.

object.description: Client properties for Dynamic DNS. A dynamic DNS client is responsible for verifying IP address changes and updating information from a subscribed account on a Dynamic DNS Server. For enabled table entries, if {{param|Server}} is not a valid reference then the table entry is inoperable and the CPE MUST set the {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.
